definitions.explanation: The moment or period right before something happens. Emphasizes very close temporal proximity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: A phone call came just before departure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}していた→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was studying right up until just before the exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}になってようやく⟦レポート→レポート：01543_repooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{始|はじ}める→書き始める：22272_kakihajimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a bad habit to only start writing the report just before the deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a temporal noun, typically in the patterns ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直前|ちょくぜん} (just before ~) or ～{直前|ちょくぜん} (immediately before ~, as a compound). Can also be used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: {直前|ちょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at the last moment). The ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ is often dropped in compound forms: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直前|ちょくぜん} = just before departure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}: just before departure
- ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}: just before an exam
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧{直前|ちょくぜん}: just before the deadline
- {直前|ちょくぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}する→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧: to cancel at the last minute

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧: immediately after (the opposite)
